verdict.rationale: Angular documents an official CLI at angular.dev/cli covering the full workflow: new, serve, test, e2e, lint, extract-i18n, update, add, config, deploy and cache. An AI agent or AI-native user could drive the whole project lifecycle from the command line, and Angular also advertises AI-forward resources and serves an llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-specific CLI features such as agent integrations or machine-readable output modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI use.
